title: Kadhi Pakora
description: A tangy yogurt-and-gram-flour curry studded with crisp gram-flour dumplings — a comforting Punjabi classic served over rice.
steps: For the pakoras, mix the second portion of besan with the chopped onion, a pinch of salt and a splash of water into a thick batter. Heat oil and deep-fry spoonfuls until golden and crisp, about 4-5 minutes. Drain and set aside.
For the kadhi, whisk the curd, first portion of besan, turmeric and salt with the water until completely smooth and lump-free.

Pour into a pot and bring to a gentle boil, stirring continuously to prevent the besan from settling and the curd from splitting. Once boiling, reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the kadhi thickens slightly.
Add the fried pakoras to the simmering kadhi and cook for another 5 minutes so they soften slightly and absorb the flavour.
For the tempering, heat ghee in a small pan. Add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, dried red chillies and curry leaves, letting them sizzle for 30 seconds. Stir in the red chilli powder off the heat.
Pour the tempering over the kadhi just before serving. Serve hot with steamed rice.
